reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.comment: Build quality is mediocre even for the price. but its a box for pc parts. Hinged side panel is convenient. my biggest issue with the case is the front panel connector wiring. no matter what i do i can not seem to get the wires to stop touching the front mounted fans. Will be returning if i cant get this problem resolved.
reviews.author: ArtyMcParty

reviews.title: Average case
reviews.comment: Solid case for the price, do wish it came with some fans though.
reviews.author: MegaT

reviews.title: It's pretty dang good on a budget
reviews.comment: The case is pretty good, but it's a bit painful to build in, alongside the front USB 3.0 ports being of dubious quality. However, the gull wing door is very nice looking and is great for accessing what you need to, since you can just slide it up and away.
reviews.author: GavinS

reviews.title: clean and pretty design
reviews.comment: The S.O. was complaining that her PC was ugly, so with some Best Buy reward certificates sitting around, decided to move her computer components into a new case.  This was by far the best and most feminine looking case they had (though I'd be happy to rock this design for my own PC as well), and in the end, it was mission accomplished as she seemed happy with it.
reviews.author: PomQMiJu

reviews.title: Awesome lil case
reviews.comment: The case was a breeze to work on  would recommend  to anyone  who wants  a nice compact build
